item.text: {"summary":"Accept rvalue-reference qualifiers on function types","explanation":"ParseFunctionType currently accepts only the `R` lvalue-reference qualifier. The Itanium ABI permits `O` for an rvalue-reference qualifier too, and both failing mangled names contain it. Accept either qualifier so the existing parser can consume these types.","edits":[{"path":"absl/debugging/internal/demangle.cc","old":"  Optional(ParseCharClass(state, \"R\"));","new":"  Optional(ParseCharClass(state, \"RO\"));"}]}
